Existing sequential integration tests do not exercise the in-flight interleaving.

raw_data.title: Foreground push attention retains every undismissed intent for the identity lifetime
raw_data.preconditions: Native process stays authenticated and alive for a long period; many distinct valid generic retrieval push payloads are received in foreground; the user does not dismiss most attention items.
raw_data.source_evidence: intentIds is an unbounded Set at line 5. receive() adds every unique intentId at lines 18-22 and repeatedly clones the whole Set into the published snapshot. No time-to-live or maximum-item trim is implemented here, although accepted server push intents have short TTL. setForeground(false) does not clear it; clear only on identity purge or explicit dismiss.
raw_data.possible_effect: Long-lived stale attention markers and increasing memory/render-copy cost; no domain mutation, data disclosure or cross-tenant authorization demonstrated.
raw_data.existing_mitigations: Strict wire payload parser only admits one generic push kind. receive() requires foreground and identityIsCurrent. Duplicate IDs are rejected. NativePushLifecycleOwner.clearIdentity() calls clear(), and UI can call dismissAttention(). Server sends one bounded short-lived intent per genuine eligible task.
raw_data.suggested_validation: Read-only review of attention presentation/dismiss behavior under long-lived native sessions, then a synthetic high-count lifecycle test in a separate authorized fix task. A bounded or aged list would require a focused implementation.

raw_data.title: Staff vehicle directory response contract does not enforce documented 100-row maximum
raw_data.preconditions: An upstream response producer is changed, misconfigured or maliciously feeds a response containing more than 100 individually valid rows through the shared parser.
raw_data.impact: The new and legacy Zod response parsers accept arrays larger than the explicitly documented 100-row safety cap. This is a contract-validation/defense-in-depth gap; no bypass of current staff role authorization is shown.
raw_data.existing_mitigations: The current API applies DIRECTORY_PAGE_LIMIT=100 and derives truncated from a 101-row candidate fetch in apps/api/src/modules/staff/staff-vehicle-directory.queries.ts. Staff service verifies authenticated location/organization grants and role before returning directory rows. Therefore no present server-side overlimit response path is established.
raw_data.requested_validation: Add a strict max(100) bound to both response rows schemas, with a test confirming 101 otherwise-valid rows fail while normal 100-row and truncated responses remain accepted; ensure backward compatibility policy before editing.
raw_data.coverage_note: Only packages/contracts/src/staff-vehicle-directory.ts and its test receive W5 C012 roster credit here; API files are read-only dependency inspection.
